name: review-loop
description: Portable adversarial review loop for written artifacts. Code Reviewer and Reality Checker always review; the initial round may add zero or multiple highly relevant Agency Agents domain experts without a seat cap. Findings are merged, accepted defects receive the smallest fix and focused checks, and a later CR+RC round validates the result. Missing catalog, sandbox, canonical-return support, or native subagents never blocks execution. A repeated blocker gets one fresh root-cause escalation before NOT-CONVERGED. Claude may optionally add a review-only Codex rescue pass. Architecture selection belongs to council.
